top5.title: Jensen Huang Leaves Nvidia After Alleged Espionage Scandal
top5.description: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang allegedly resigned with immediate effect after revelations about an affair with someone suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence. Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO, while Nvidia shares fell more than 13% at the open.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s alleged immediate departure from Nvidia would shock AI markets, threaten confidence in the sector’s dominant chip supplier, and expose major succession and geopolitical risks.

top5.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Email, Teams and Intune
top5.description: A Microsoft 365 outage on November 12 disrupted access to email, some Teams features and administration tools such as Intune. Microsoft cited server health-check failures and an overloaded server process.
top5.why: The Microsoft 365 outage highlights the operational and concentration risks businesses face when core email, collaboration, and device-management services depend on one cloud provider.

top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO Reportedly Six Times Oversubscribed
top5.description: Anthropic’s IPO reportedly attracted about six times more demand than the number of shares offered. During its roadshow, the company also said Claude had been ported to AMD GPUs in three days, compared with several months previously.
top5.why: Anthropic’s reportedly six-times-oversubscribed IPO signals intense investor demand for leading AI companies while its rapid migration to AMD GPUs points to growing competition in AI hardware.

top5.title: United Airlines Blocks Unauthorized Personal AI Agents
top5.description: United is restricting unauthorized personal AI agents, citing unintended purchases, exposure of account information and regulatory obligations. Analysts note that the lack of consistent standards and the difficulty of distinguishing bots from customers complicate transaction automation.
top5.why: United’s decision to block unauthorized AI agents shows that companies are beginning to set commercial, privacy, and regulatory rules for agents acting on customers’ behalf.

top5.title: Australia wants to require independent audits of cutting-edge AI
top5.description: The Australian government is proposing mandatory safety rules for companies developing the most advanced models. A regulator could have these models audited by independent experts and impose penalties.
top5.why: Australia’s proposal for mandatory independent audits and penalties for frontier AI developers signals a shift toward enforceable safety oversight rather than voluntary commitments.
